mapper.select: SELECT * FROM video_bounty_evidence WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY id

SELECT e.* FROM video_bounty_evidence e JOIN video_bounty_submission s ON s.id = e.submission_id WHERE s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND s.origin_group_key = #{originGroupKey} AND s.status IN (0, 1, 2) AND s.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY e.id

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(e.id), 0) FROM video_bounty_evidence e JOIN video_bounty_submission s ON s.id = e.submission_id WHERE s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND s.verified_group_key = #{verifiedGroupKey} AND s.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_bounty_evidence (submission_id, evidence_type, source_ref, captured_by, period_start, period_end, views, organic, verifiable, note, evidence_hash, create_time) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{evidenceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{capturedBy}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{views}, #{organic}, #{verifiable}, #{note}, #{evidenceHash}, NOW())
